name: Barometer
description: Air pressure on an aneroid dial, with a settable marker needle for the earlier reading and the trend written beneath.

props.name: value
props.description: The current reading. The main needle springs to it whenever it changes.

props.name: previous
props.description: The earlier reading, shown by the marker needle. The trend is the gap between the two. Defaults to the current value.

props.name: min
props.description: The value at the left end of the scale.

props.name: max
props.description: The value at the right end of the scale.

props.name: hours
props.description: How long ago the previous reading was taken, for the trend line.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit written on the dial and after values.

props.name: words
props.description: The weather words set round the dial and the readings they sit at. Defaults to Stormy, Rain, Change, Fair and Very dry.

props.name: size
props.description: Largest dial diameter in pixels. The dial shrinks to fit the card.

props.name: settable
props.description: Show a Set marker button that moves the marker needle onto the current reading.

props.name: onPreviousChange
props.description: Called when the marker is set from the button.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes readings. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the dial shows, for screen readers. Generated from the readings when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: note
props.description: A muted line under the label.

props.name: action
props.description: Replaces the Set marker button on the right of the header.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts every other prop of a div.
